name: Smoked buffalo
summary: The 2019 feature says Thai villages in Mai Châu smoke buffalo. The cut it names is loin and shoulder, sliced with the grain, seasoned with lemongrass, ginger, garlic, dried chili, and mắc khén, then hung in the smoke for months. A good piece stays somewhat red.
origin: The 26 Aug 2019 Vĩnh Long feature, citing Báo Cần Thơ. It is a newspaper feature, not the tourism office.
texture: A good piece stays somewhat red, on the 2019 feature.
howToEat: With rượu Mai Hạ. The hour is Check on arrival.
